reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent-driven Chromium automation, providing structured navigation and interaction tools, page inspection, scripting and CDP control, file transfer, authentication-state handling, and a live observation window with human takeover.

summaries.zh: 将 Chromium 浏览器接入 DeepSeek Harness，为智能体提供结构化网页浏览、页面交互、脚本与 CDP 控制，以及可实时观察和接管的浏览器窗口。
summaries.en: Connects Chromium to DeepSeek Harness with structured web navigation and interaction, scripting and CDP control, plus a live browser view that humans can observe and take over.

capabilities: Controls Chromium through structured browser actions and CDP
Navigates pages and reads semantic page content
Fills forms, clicks, scrolls, drags, selects, and sends keyboard input
Executes page JavaScript, browser scripts, raw CDP commands, and heredoc CLI actions
Captures screenshots and live browser video, and supports direct human interaction through an observation window
Uploads and downloads files and detects CAPTCHA or browser dialogs
Persists browser authentication state within task spaces and performs browser-context HTTP requests
